recipe_title: Rice Vermicelli Bowls with Bok Choy and Adzuki Beans

ingredients.name: 4 heads baby bok choy, roughly chopped (1 lb. total)
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 heads baby bok choy, roughly chopped (1 lb. total)

ingredients.name: . can no-salt-added adzuki beans, rinsed and drained (1½ cups)
ingredients.raw: 1 15-oz. can no-salt-added adzuki beans, rinsed and drained (1½ cups)

ingredients.name: ½ of a 14-oz. package lite firm tofu, drained, cut into ¼-inch cubes
ingredients.raw: ½ of a 14-oz. package lite firm tofu, drained, cut into ¼-inch cubes

ingredients.name: miso paste, mixed with 2 tablespoons water
ingredients.raw: 1 tablespoon miso paste, mixed with 2 tablespoons water

ingredients.name: . package dry thin brown rice noodles (rice vermicelli), broken
ingredients.raw: 1 8-oz. package dry thin brown rice noodles (rice vermicelli), broken

ingredients.name: ¼ cup thinly sliced fresh Thai basil
ingredients.raw: ¼ cup thinly sliced fresh Thai basil

instructions: In a large pot combine broth, garlic, ginger, crushed red pepper, and 2 cups water. Bring to boiling. Stir in bok choy, beans, bell pepper, and tofu. Reduce heat. Simmer 2 minutes or until bok choy is tender.

Stir in miso paste. Turn off heat. Stir in noodles, mushrooms, and scallions. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes or until noodles are softened. Spoon into bowls and top with radishes, basil, and sesame seeds. If desired, serve with sriracha sauce.
